answer: An honest agent waits once; a farm waits a hundred times, and the lagoon is that the reward arrives only after the wait. The prism is a business that loses money by existing. Each identity costs a one-per-person interview slot that books out months ahead, so scale means waiting, not just paying, and the atlas is that parallel spending cannot shorten a queue. Calendar time is the one input a farm cannot buy in bulk. Elected bailiff licence with bailiffs association endorsement spends it through a licence bailiffs renew after warrant audits.
